subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution: The correct answer is "Most." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The reason for using the word **"most"** in the blank is to indicate a majority or a large portion of the fears. (अधिकांश) • By using** "most,"** we are suggesting that the majority of the fears people experience are unreasonable. • It provides a quantifying term to emphasize the prevalence of irrational fears in the context of the sentence. • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. • Correct paragraph: No matter how much we like honey or how much we have read about the uncanny sense of direction which bees possess, we have a horror of being stung. **Most**__ of our fears are unreasonable but they are difficult to erase. At the same time, however, insects are strangely fascinating. We enjoy reading about them, especially when we find that, like the praying mantis, they lead perfectly horrible lives. We enjoy staring at them, entranced as they go ______ (5) ______ their business, unaware (we hope) of our presence. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **Few: **not many. (थोड़े-से, गिने-चुने; बहुत-से नहीं) • **Several: **more than two but not very many; a few. (दो से कुछ अधिक (बहुत अधिक नहीं), अनेक; कुछ) • **Some: **a certain amount of or a number of. ((किसी वस्‍तु की) निश्चित या विशेष मात्रा या संख्‍या; कुछ राशि) 46:T736, The correct answer is "about."
